rows.what_the_ink_shows: In crops/6_scan020_L700_abelian_assertion.jpg the uncancelled typescript reads “Comme les cristaux de modules sur un préschéma S forment une catégorie abélienne, on peut prendre la catégorie dérivée; ses objets seront appelés simplement” followed by “complexes de cristaux”. No condition of smoothness or a perfect base field is inserted into that sentence. In crops/6_scan020_L700_deletion_boundary.jpg the preceding definition beginning “On ... désigne” is enclosed and crossed by deletion strokes through its final words “base variable,”; the boundary turns up before Comme and does not cancel the assertion about crystals. The original LaTeX correctly ends its deleted passage before the quoted assertion.
rows.note: Preserve the written assertion unchanged. The supplied sweep-3 SA15 row proposes a mathematical qualification and a different derived-category formulation; those are not visible corrections or omitted words in this passage. Its reference to smoothness over a perfect field, its discussion of kernels in O_C-modules, and the perfect-field unit-crystal example are carried only as attributed table background, not as conclusions of this visual review. The table reports that Michel Hua’s project raised the issue; this does not supply contrary written ink. The reference to 1.13 was not independently checked. Both crops use Pillow LANCZOS enlargement to 2800 pixels across and contrast factor 1.6.
rows.event_type: used and rechecked in this run
rows.event_outcome: Compared the original passage with the full scan and two enhanced crops. Confirmed the unqualified abelian-category assertion and that the previous deletion ends before it. This was a visual/textual check only; no kernel calculation or categorical theorem was verified.

additional_events.type: carried as background without fault found
additional_events.outcome: The supplied sweep-3 SA15 row L700 says the abelian-category assertion is true for S smooth over a perfect field, citing 1.13, but that crystals are not generally closed under kernels in O_C-modules; it proposes the derived category of O_C-modules with crystal cohomology. These are attributed mathematical refinements, not independently proved in this review.

additional_events.outcome: The supplied sweep-3 SA15 row L700 gives the sheaf kernel of p on the unit crystal over a perfect field as p^{n-1}W_n on W_n and says that it is not cartesian. That example and the reported attribution to Michel Hua’s project are carried as table background; the kernel computation and cartesian condition were not checked.
